title: Tesla Stock (TSLA) Rises 4.2% on Cybertruck Production Shift (Nov 6)
summary: Tesla stock (TSLA) rose 4.23% to $358.22 on Nov 6 after Elon Musk said Cybertruck production at Giga Texas will wind down to make room for Cybercab.
body_markdown:
## Why Tesla Stock Rose


The main company news came from Musk himself. In a[post on X](https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2118591788701421573) published early Friday, before the US market opened, Musk wrote that "Tesla will be winding down production of the Cybertruck at Gigafactory Texas around the middle of next year to make room for increased Cybercab production." According to[Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/tesla-wind-down-cybertruck-production-texas-factory-next-year-make-room-cybercab) , Musk called the Cybertruck the "best vehicle Tesla has ever made" and described the change as the "end of an era."


As reported by[24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/06/tesla-jumped-4-the-morning-musk-killed-the-cybertruck-and-investors-know-what-replaces-it/) , the gain "likely reflects relief that Musk is cutting a weak product." The outlet noted that Tesla has issued no press release on the change and that its October 21, 2026 8-K filing still lists the Cybertruck in its lineup.


The wider backdrop also played a part. Per[24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/06/nio-climbs-6-tesla-and-lucid-rise-5-as-ev-stocks-rebound-from-election-sell-off/) , EV stocks recovered on Friday from the selling that followed the US midterm elections, after[Tesla fell on November 5 on regulatory concerns once Democrats took control of Congress](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/tesla-tsla-stock-news-november-6-2026/) . The outlet described the Cybertruck post as one factor among several.


## TSLA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Robotaxi footprint: Tesla began offering paid Cybercab rides in Austin in September, and about 570 of the more than 1,200 Tesla robotaxis in Texas are Cybercabs, according to state DMV figures cited by Fox Business.
- Capacity shift: Musk framed the Giga Texas change as making room for more Cybercab output, and Tesla lists installed Cybercab capacity of more than 125,000 units, per Fox Business.
- Sector rebound: EV shares recovered on Friday from the post-election sell-off, as reported by 24/7 Wall St.


### Risks


- Cybertruck demand: US Cybertruck sales fell 48% to 20,237 in 2025 from 38,965 in 2024, according to Kelley Blue Book data cited by Fox Business.
- Few details so far: the post gave no firm end date, restructuring charge or Cybercab output target, and 24/7 Wall St. noted that the outlook still depends on regulatory approvals for the Cybercab.
- Regulatory review: the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened an audit in September of whether Tesla properly self-certified the Cybercab under federal safety standards, per Fox Business.
